# Pixel Memory Match

A simple, offline memory match game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## How to Play

- Click or tap a card to flip it.
- Flip two cards per turn. If they match (same color), they stay open.
- If they don't match, they flip back after a short delay.
- The game ends when all 8 pairs are matched.
- The move counter tracks how many pairs you've flipped.
- Click "New Game" to reset and shuffle the deck.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total).
- Move counter and win message.
- Keyboard accessible: use Tab to navigate cards, Enter or Space to flip.
- Fully responsive from 360px width.
- No external dependencies, assets, or network requests.

## Files

- `index.html` – Main page structure.
- `styles.css` – Styling and layout.
- `script.js` – Game logic.

## Running

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server required.
